resources.string: Keeps notification code detection available and reports its health.
Notification access is disabled; tap Repair
Permission is enabled, but the listener is disconnected; tap Repair
Shizuku Manager is installed, but its Binder service was not received. Start Shizuku and try again.
This Shizuku API version does not support the optional repair service. Standard repair has still been requested.
Shizuku permission was denied. Allow OTP Helper in Shizuku Manager, then try again.
Approve the optional Shizuku permission, then run its repair again.
Shizuku settings were applied, but OTP Helper cannot post the verification notification. Grant notification permission first.
Shizuku settings were applied, but the notification listener did not connect.

Shizuku settings were applied, but OTP Helper still could not read the verification code from the external notification body. Shizuku is not providing a usable notification-reading path on this device.
Shizuku repair completed and the external notification-body read test passed.

Aggressive firmware can disconnect notification access even after the standard permissions are granted. The foreground service, listener rebind heartbeat, WorkManager watchdog and Alarm recovery are the supported resilience paths.
On HONOR MagicOS, also open Recents and swipe down on the OTP Helper card until the lock icon appears. OTP Helper is no longer hidden from Recents.

Optional repair only. Shizuku can reapply notification access and, on Android 15 or later, the sensitive-notification AppOp. It is treated as useful only when a random six-digit code posted by shell is readable through the real cross-package notification body. Shizuku Binder detection uses the official Provider and asynchronous listener lifecycle.
Shizuku status: Manager detected, Binder service not connected
Shizuku status: Binder connected (API %1$d, UID %2$d, permission %3$s)

Generate a redacted diagnostic report containing the current permissions, actual notification-listener connection, latest external notification-body probe, service state, watchdog state, Shizuku Binder state, device information and recent OTP Helper logs.
